source_title: Attack on Titan’s Main Cast Inspires Bold New Figure Line - GameRant
source_excerpt:
Carley spends her free time gaming with her husband, scoping out breweries and wineries, playing with her cat Momo, and writing self-indulgent fanfiction. She prefers lore-heavy RPGs and walking sims and has only played Dragon Age: Inquisition 14 times. Her favorite Final Fantasy game is all of them.
Fans of Attack on Titan won't want to miss out on some upcoming merchandise, though which items customers snag will all come down to a game of chance. Though the manga and anime series have both come to an end, passion for Attack on Titan hasn't waned, and now, fans may be able to snag a figure of their favorite character doing the iconic 'Dedicate Your Heart' pose. If not, there are plenty of other unique prizes on the line.
While Eren's journey has technically ended, fans around the world still have even more to look forward to in 2027. Earlier this month, it was confirmed that Attack on Titan: The Musical would be embarking on a world tour starting in Singapore from April 15 to May 2, 2027. Future dates and locations have yet to be confirmed, but fans around the globe are excited to potentially be able to experience the show for themselves. Go Ueki is directing the musical, while the hip-hop artist KEN THE 390 is acting as the music director, and series creator Hajime Isayama has gone on record to applaud the work.
Ichiban Kuji Reveals New Collection of Iconic Attack on Titan Figures and More
Ichiban Kuji is a sure-win lottery game in Japan run by Bandai Spirits, and a new group of prizes inspired by Attack on Titan has been revealed , set to take place from October 24 until November 17, 2026 at participating locations and Ichiban Kuji Online . One ticket will cost ¥850 (around $5.40), and fans will have the chance to snag a variety of goods, including figures of the main cast doing the iconic 'Dedicate Your Heart' pose. Those who don't snag a figure can still look forward to taking home posters, stickers, mini plushies, and more. Whoever draws the final ticket will take home a nearly foot-high Levi figure, with the popular character on horseback ready to take on his next foe.
2026 has been a packed year for the Attack on Titan franchise. A slew of goods depicting Levi and Erin as prisoners and guards was unveiled this summer, and last month, a collaboration with the Japanese gym chain chocoZAP was announced. The latter has been an incredible success, attracting young people and inspiring them to start exercising regularly. Those who attended the gym regularly during the event were treated to exclusive goods.
MAPPA, the studio behind the final season of Attack on Titan , celebrated its 15th anniversary in July, with celebrations planned throughout 2026. The studio released several new visuals to celebrate its most popular works over the summer, including Chainsaw Man and Jujutsu Kaisen . The MAPPA Expo 15th Anniversary event is currently being held at the Yurakucho Museum in Tokyo until December 7, 2026, and guests can enjoy large-scale installations and video presentations honoring many of the studio's works, along with exclusive merchandise and bonuses.
The Attack on Titan manga series concluded in 2021, and its anime adaptation wrapped up in 2023 after a decade, but this hasn't stopped its passionate fandom from continuing to show love for Isayama's work. Over the years, the creator's magnum opus won several major awards, including the Kodansha Manga Award for Best Shonen manga , the Manga Taisho for Best Manga Series, and, notably, a Harvey Award for Best American Edition of Foreign Material in 2014. On the video game front, fans also have something new to look forward to, as Attack on Titan 3 will be released on December 10 for PC, PS5, Switch 2, and Xbox Series X/S.
